targetText: Lisa was in complete disagreement with the new policy; she stood with the boys of the factory.
explanation: Vassilissa's return to active party organizing restores her sense of purpose and revolutionary identity away from domestic isolation.

targetText: That's because you're a manager's wife. If you had been living by yourself you would have come back to work very soon.
explanation: Lisa points out how domestic living with a managerial spouse isolated Vassilissa from active working-class struggle.
